professionalSummary.text: Three years as Project Coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor, managing possession plans, works schedules, and records across three sites.
professionalSummary.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Kept possession plans and works schedules current weekly based on contractor progress reports for three renewal sites.
experienceHighlights.witness: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded possession briefings and site access permits under programme procedures, with two infrastructure owner audits finding no issues.
experienceHighlights.witness: The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared and delivered weekly progress reports to the infrastructure owner's representative, with comments documented in the programme folder.
experienceHighlights.witness: The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked equipment deliveries against schedule in a delivery log, resolving queries with suppliers and escalating possession decisions to the project manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented hand-over notes at each commissioning stage, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes a month of possession plan updates, possession briefing records, weekly progress reports, and commissioning hand-over notes, with programme folder references for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand-over note, with the programme folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Possession planning, works scheduling, record-keeping, equipment delivery tracking, commissioning hand-over documentation.
skills.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.
